ana_fin: Quick alert 1 APAC carrier (NimbleNet) issued a surprise adjustment INV-NN-712 for $54,120. Vendor labels it "retro tariff recalculation (Oct-Dec 2025)". Not in our forecast. Need guidance on revenue vs COGS and whether this triggers a prior-period adjustment. cc @ellie_rev @olivia_fp&a
ellie_rev: Key Qs: (1) did we pass this cost through to customers? (2) were customer invoices explicit on egress lines? (3) materiality check for the quarter.
matt_billing: Uploaded docs: https://drive.redwood/finance/apac/INV-NN-712.pdf. Billing match shows explicit egress lines on several invoices totaling $38,900; remainder $15,220 absorbed. CSV will be uploaded in 30m.
olivia_fp&a: Materiality threshold for the quarter = $30k. This exceeds it. Recommend prepare JE options and a disclosure note.
billing-bot: INV-NN-712 entered to AP staging. Suggested GL staging: Dr 2002 Accrued-Vendor / Cr 2100 AP Clearing.
ellie_rev: If pass-through -> adjust revenue schedules (prior-period adjustment). If absorbed -> COGS true-up. Audit to be notified either way.
action items: ana_fin -> upload per-customer breakout with rev_schedule_id and contract_rebill_flag; matt_billing -> prepare sample JE drafts; olivia_fp&a -> draft disclosure language; ellie_rev -> final sign-off. ETA EOD.
